tasks.subject: Task 1: Fix the two live canvas defects
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A canvas overlay can no longer perform an IPC read per frame on the draw path, and a throwing overlay is disabled after one throw instead of throwing forever. Independent of the widget feature — shippable alone (spec §6).

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui.js` — `createCanvasRuntimeContext` (:16517), `invokeCanvasOverlayHook` (:16566)
- Test: `tests/host/test_canvas_overlay_containment.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `invokeCanvasOverlayHook` disables the overlay after its first throw; the hook is not invoked again for that runtime
- [ ] The disable is recorded on `canvasRuntime` and surfaced via `canvasRuntime.error`, not silently swallowed
- [ ] `getParam`/`setParam`/`getValue`/`setValue` remain available to `onOpen`/`onMidi`/`onClose`/`onExit`, and are ABSENT during `draw` and `tick`
- [ ] A doc comment at the ctx names the ~2.8 ms cost and why the draw path is excluded

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_canvas_overlay_containment.sh` → all PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing test → confirm 4 FAILs → add `canvasRuntime.hookDisabled` one-strike to `invokeCanvasOverlayHook` → add `DRAW_PATH_HOOKS` set + `canvasHookCtx(hookName)` stripping the four accessors → confirm 4 PASS → run full `tests/host/*.sh` for regressions → commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: frame_ctx.mjs — frame-local drawing context
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure drawing context scoped to one rect: (0,0) is the frame's top-left, everything is clipped to it, text is truncated rather than overflowed, and attempted overflow is counted so tests can assert zero.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/shared/param_pages/frame_ctx.mjs`
- Test: `tests/host/test_frame_ctx.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `frameCtx(ctx, {x,y,w,h})` exposes `width`, `height`, `fillRect`, `print`, `textWidth`, `clipped()`
- [ ] A fillRect fully inside reaches the parent translated by x,y
- [ ] A fillRect partly outside is clipped to the frame and increments `clipped()`
- [ ] A fillRect fully outside draws nothing and increments `clipped()`
- [ ] Negative coordinates clamp to the frame origin, never above or left of it
- [ ] `print` truncates to fit using `textWidth`, never overflowing
- [ ] No property is the parent ctx; no `getParam`/`setParam`

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_frame_ctx.sh` → 13 PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing test → confirm module-not-found → write `frame_ctx.mjs` with `clipToFrame` helper, truncating `print`, `clipped()` counter → confirm 13 PASS → MUTATE the clamp (`x1 > w + 100`) and confirm the clip assertions FAIL, then revert → commit. ExtFS has 1-second mtime granularity; if a mutation seems inert, `touch` the file first.

```json:metadata

```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Custom viz kinds resolve and fall through
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `viz: { kind: "custom:<name>" }` is recognised in chain_params, claims its keys ONLY when the name is registered, and otherwise leaves them to the detector. `collectDeclared` claims keys as it walks, so an unregistered custom kind simply not claiming gives exact fall-through with no fallback bookkeeping — one branch covering a typo, a failed load, an older host reading a newer module, and a one-strike disable.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/shared/param_pages/widget_registry.mjs` (registry half only)
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz.mjs` — `collectDeclared` (:203), imports
- Test: `tests/host/test_custom_viz_resolve.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `isCustomKind("custom:x")` true; `isCustomKind("envelope")` false; `isCustomKind(null)` false
- [ ] A registered custom single claims its key, `source: "declared"`
- [ ] A registered custom group with group/role spans its adjacent run
- [ ] An UNREGISTERED custom kind claims nothing; the detector still produces its built-in group (assert the DRAWN RESULT, not merely that nothing threw)
- [ ] No built-in kind name starts with `custom:`

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_custom_viz_resolve.sh` → 8 PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing test → create `widget_registry.mjs` (isCustomKind/registerWidget/isWidgetAvailable/getWidget/clearWidgets) → add the guard in `collectDeclared` after the typeof check AND in the group loop after kind resolution → confirm 8 PASS → confirm fleet snapshot unmoved → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/shared/param_pages/widget_registry.mjs", "src/shared/param_pages/viz.mjs", "tests/host/test_custom_viz_resolve.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_custom_viz_resolve.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_viz.sh && bash tests/host/test_viz_gather.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["isCustomKind discriminates", "registered single claims", "registered group spans", "unregistered falls through to a real detector group", "fleet snapshot unmoved"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Dispatch custom widgets, one strike and out
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `drawVizGroup` routes a `custom:` kind through the registry into a frame-local ctx; a throw disables that kind for the session and the built-in takes over from the next resolve.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/widget_registry.mjs` — add `frameCtx` import at TOP, then append `setWidgetLogger` + `drawCustom`
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/viz_draw.mjs` — `drawVizGroup` (:1717), imports
- Test: `tests/host/test_widget_one_strike.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A registered widget's `draw` gets a frame-local ctx whose width/height are the rect's
- [ ] The widget receives values/meta as arguments; its ctx has no `getParam`
- [ ] A widget that throws is invoked EXACTLY ONCE; `isWidgetAvailable` false afterwards
- [ ] After the disable, `resolveViz` no longer claims those keys, so the detector's built-in group draws
- [ ] A widget drawing outside its frame produces zero out-of-frame parent calls

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_widget_one_strike.sh` → 7 PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing test → add import at top of registry, append `drawCustom` (try/catch → `disabled.add(kind)` → return false) → replace `drawVizGroup` to branch on `isCustomKind` → confirm 7 PASS → run full `tests/host/*.sh` → commit.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Wire canvas.js drawCell into the registry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A real module shipping `canvas.js` with a `drawCell` export has its widget registered when the component editor loads it, and unregistered when the component unloads. End-to-end point of the feature.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui.js` — imports (~:257), one-time `setWidgetLogger(debugLog)`, `loadCanvasOverlay` (after :16623), teardown (:16308)
- Test: `tests/host/test_canvas_drawcell_wiring.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] An overlay exporting `drawCell` + `widgetKind` registers under that kind on load
- [ ] `clearWidgets()` runs on component teardown so a widget cannot outlive its module (the registry is process-global and shadow_ui long-lived; a later module reusing the name would inherit the wrong art)
- [ ] `setWidgetLogger(debugLog)` installed once at startup
- [ ] A non-function `drawCell` is ignored without throwing

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_canvas_drawcell_wiring.sh` → 5 PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing source-pin test → add import + `setWidgetLogger` → register in `loadCanvasOverlay` guarded on `typeof overlay.drawCell === "function" && typeof overlay.widgetKind === "string"` → `clearWidgets()` in teardown → confirm 5 PASS → parse-check via dynamic import catching SyntaxError (`node --check` silently passes on broken .js here) → commit.

tasks.subject: Task 6: The frame-instability matrix
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the same widget survives every rect the two renderers can actually produce. A single-size snapshot passing proves nothing here, because the entire reason the frame ctx is stronger than clipping is that the rect VARIES.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/host/test_widget_frame_matrix.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Matrix covers movy 32×15 and the knob box 17×15, each mode `computeGeom` selects (dial full radius, dial reduced, bar-value, bar-label, bar-only), a two-cell span, a right-edge clamped span, and two degenerate frames
- [ ] In every cell, a polite widget sized to width/height clips nothing
- [ ] In every cell, a greedy widget is CONTAINED and its overflow is COUNTED (a green matrix only proves the axis you chose — the greedy widget goes through the same matrix)
- [ ] Label ownership needs NO assertion: `render_page_movy.mjs:2438` passes `h: lblY - rowY`, excluding the label band, so it is a property of the caller. Do not add a test pretending otherwise.

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_widget_frame_matrix.sh` → 44 PASS (11 frames × 4), no FAIL

**Steps:** Write the matrix test → confirm 44 PASS → MUTATE by removing the `x1 > w` clamp in frame_ctx and confirm "greedy widget is contained" FAILs across the matrix → revert. ExtFS 1-second mtime granularity: if the mutation seems inert, `touch` frame_ctx.mjs first.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/host/test_widget_frame_matrix.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_widget_frame_matrix.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["matrix covers all real renderer rects", "polite widget clips nothing", "greedy widget contained everywhere", "greedy overflow counted", "mutation proves the matrix can fail"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: RLE sprite runtime and nominal-frame anchoring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Decode run-length sprite data into fillRect runs, and anchor a sprite's nominal frame inside the real frame — refusing (so the built-in draws) rather than fractionally scaling. A binding is ~490ns: a 17×15 knob box per-pixel is 255 calls ≈125µs, and A PAGE HOLDS EIGHT, so ~1ms of a 1.68ms render. Runs give ~45 calls ≈22µs. The full-page figure is what makes this non-optional.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/shared/param_pages/sprite_rle.mjs`
- Test: `tests/host/test_sprite_rle.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `drawSprite` emits one fillRect per RUN of set pixels, not per pixel
- [ ] A sprite whose nominal w/h exceeds the frame draws NOTHING and reports refusal
- [ ] A sprite exactly half the frame in both axes may draw at integer scale 2; 1.5x is never produced
- [ ] `anchorSprite` centres at integer offsets
- [ ] A 17×15 striped sprite emits ≤3 runs per row

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_sprite_rle.sh` → 12 PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing test → write `sprite_rle.mjs` exporting `spriteFromRows`, `anchorSprite`, `drawSprite`, `drawSpriteAnchored` → confirm 12 PASS → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/shared/param_pages/sprite_rle.mjs", "tests/host/test_sprite_rle.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_sprite_rle.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["runs not pixels", "oversized sprite refused not scaled", "integer scale only on exact multiple", "centred at integer offsets", "run economy within 3 per row"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: widget_gen.mjs — the no-JS path
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A C-only author writes `widgets.toml` beside their PNGs, runs one node command, and commits a generated `widgets.mjs` exporting `widgetKind`, `widgetNominal` and `drawCell`. The declarative tier runs on THEIR machine, so a malformed sprite config is a red build for the person who wrote it rather than a broken widget for whoever installed the module.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/param-pages/widget_gen.mjs`
- Test: `tests/host/test_widget_gen_roundtrip.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Reads `kind`, `nominal`, `frames`
- [ ] Emits a .mjs exporting `widgetKind`, `widgetNominal`, `drawCell`
- [ ] FAILS AT BUILD TIME if any frame's dimensions differ from declared `nominal` (the load-bearing check)
- [ ] Rejects a kind lacking the `custom:` prefix
- [ ] Round-trip: PNG → RLE → drawn runs reproduce the source set pixels exactly, compared BY CONTENT (zlib is not byte-stable)
- [ ] Generated output is deterministic across two runs
- [ ] Generated code never references `getParam`

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_widget_gen_roundtrip.sh` → 8 PASS, no FAIL

**Steps:** Write failing test → write `widget_gen.mjs` with `runsFromRows` + `generate(spec)` throwing on nominal mismatch and on a missing `custom:` prefix → confirm 8 PASS → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/param-pages/widget_gen.mjs", "tests/host/test_widget_gen_roundtrip.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_widget_gen_roundtrip.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["emits widgetKind widgetNominal drawCell", "nominal mismatch fails the build", "kind without custom: prefix rejected", "round trip by content", "deterministic output", "no getParam in generated code"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Validator, docs, regenerated widget sheet
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A malformed `custom:` declaration is reported by validate_contract, docs/MODULES.md covers custom widgets, and CLAUDE.md gains its one index bullet.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/validate_contract.mjs`
- Modify: `docs/MODULES.md` (author section + regenerated sheet), `docs/PARAM_PAGES.md` (the prose), `CLAUDE.md` (ONE bullet)
- Test: `tests/host/test_custom_viz_validate.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] An unknown `custom:` kind is NOT an error — it is exactly what an older host sees reading a newer module, and it degrades on its own
- [ ] A `custom:` kind on a module shipping no `canvas_script` is a WARNING (the author forgot the file; nothing else would ever say so)
- [ ] docs/MODULES.md documents drawCell/widgetKind/widgetNominal, the frame contract, that the label is not the widget's, one-strike, forward-compat degradation, and the generator invocation
- [ ] `node tools/param-pages/widget_sheet.mjs --manual` regenerated; `bash tests/host/test_widget_sheet.sh` passes (it also fails on an ORPHANED image — review images as well as prose)
- [ ] CLAUDE.md gains EXACTLY ONE bullet under the PARAM_PAGES hook, not the prose (the index rule)

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_custom_viz_validate.sh && bash tests/host/test_widget_sheet.sh` → all PASS

**Steps:** Write failing validator test → add the warning rule → confirm 3 PASS → write the MODULES.md author section → regenerate the sheet → write the PARAM_PAGES.md section → add the single CLAUDE.md bullet → run `make -C tests/host test` plus all `tests/host/*.sh` → commit.
